t: Milwaukee M18 BLCS66-401B is a robust 190mm 18V cordless circular saw, engineered for efficient and precise cutting on professional job sites. Features a high-performance brushless motor which delivers up to 5000rpm, enabling fast cuts in timber and sheet materials. RedLink overload protection within both the tool and the RedLithium-Ion battery pack ensures system durability and extended run time, making it suitable for carpenters, roofers, and general builders requiring consistent power and reliability. The professional power tool offers a substantial 66mm cutting depth at 90°, ideal for various construction applications. Supplied with blade, battery, charger and durable canvas carry bag for convenient transport and storage.
